title: Section 7 validators, robustness, review, and provenance
description: Complete artifact typings for the 17 mechanisms in MECHANISMS.md Section 7, preserving validation, development diagnostics, review custody, known-good projections, and privileged upper bounds as distinct contracts.

artifactTypes.label: Exact input bytes
artifactTypes.description: Byte-exact supplied input used for replay, cache identity, and custody without filename or corpus lookup semantics.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.2, 7.9, and 7.15 require exact source or input bytes.
provenanceNotes: Content identity is byte-derived; paths and prefix IDs are not identity substitutes.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.

notes: Stable identity of the supplied encoded artwork image.
Stable identity of this exact native decode.
The native opaque contract admits only decodes with no alpha-bearing pixels.
Inspection paths expose source identity, decode identity, and the opaque success condition without changing raster topology.

sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: Exact v3 UI Palette product contract
artifactTypes.description: The published v3 Palette contract with complete four-role treatment, collapse state, optional rendered field, exact-pixel rules, and required contract metadata.

sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.1 accepts one complete treatment for structural validation.
provenanceNotes: This product-goal artifact is intentionally input-only in this fragment; Section 7 does not produce a palette.

artifactTypes.label: Exact source identity envelope
artifactTypes.description: Harness-side source path, content hash, rendition, dimensions, and custody mapping needed for review or provenance operations.
sourceNotes: STRATEGY.md 4, 5, and 7 require exact source and rendition custody.
provenanceNotes: The envelope is available only to custody or review harness operations, never as a mechanism identity shortcut.

artifactTypes.label: Pinned renderer identity
artifactTypes.description: Renderer implementation, version, configuration, and rendition contract used by validation or blinded review.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.1, 7.12, and 7.13 require a resolved or pinned renderer.
provenanceNotes: Renderer changes create a new configuration identity.

artifactTypes.label: Native color occupancy
artifactTypes.description: Source-bound occupancy witnesses for colors in the native raster.

notes: Identity of the native raster whose colors were measured.
Distinct exact colors occupied by at least one native pixel.
Inspection binds occupancy witnesses to their exact native raster and occupied-color set.

sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.1 requires native occupancy for source-color checks.
provenanceNotes: Measurements retain native-raster and color-space identity.

artifactTypes.label: Resolved contract constants
artifactTypes.description: Frozen exact-pixel, contrast, gradient, collapse, and escape constants for one contract revision.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.1 requires resolved contract constants.
provenanceNotes: The contract revision and every behavior-affecting value are explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Contract invariant scorecard
artifactTypes.description: Pass/fail structural scorecard with named invariant violations and exact witnesses; it carries no aesthetic or semantic quality judgment.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Mechanical contract gate result, explicitly separate from human product-quality review.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.1 defines pass/fail and named violations, not quality authority.
provenanceNotes: Each finding binds the treatment, constants, occupancy, and renderer identities.

artifactTypes.label: Replay computation controls
artifactTypes.description: Fixed code, configuration, preprocessing, decoder, environment, execution-order, and repeat-count declarations for one replay scope.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.2 scopes replay to the exact controls exercised.
provenanceNotes: Uncontrolled decoders, schedules, float environments, relabeling, and iteration orders remain named exclusions.

artifactTypes.label: Deterministic replay report
artifactTypes.description: Exact equality, first-divergence, and stop-the-line replay result under one frozen control envelope.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Determinism diagnostic; equality does not establish correctness or quality.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.2 defines same-byte repeat and order-invariance reporting.
provenanceNotes: The report binds input bytes and the complete exercised control envelope.

artifactTypes.label: Controlled perturbation policy
artifactTypes.description: Declared re-encode, plus-or-minus-one-LSB dither, rendition-pair, stratification, and agreement classification policy.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.3 names controlled re-encodes, dithers, and rendition pairs.
provenanceNotes: Every non-native transform, seed, and information change is declared.

artifactTypes.label: Controlled rendition pair
artifactTypes.description: Two exact renditions of one source with accounted information and transform differences.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.3 permits controlled rendition-pair comparisons.
provenanceNotes: Both byte identities, decoders, dimensions, and known transform differences are retained.

artifactTypes.label: Perturbation robustness report
artifactTypes.description: Per-role and treatment movement, changed-destination classes, and stratified exact or same-color agreement without aesthetic interpretation.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Development robustness diagnostic with agreement, disagreement, and move rates kept distinct.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.3 defines the robustness output classes.
provenanceNotes: Results bind each transformed input to its unperturbed source and policy.

artifactTypes.label: Frozen corpus run
artifactTypes.description: Immutable development run over a declared corpus, code identity, and configuration for sensitivity analysis.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.4 requires a frozen corpus or run.
provenanceNotes: Run membership, source hashes, code, and configuration are fixed before outcomes are compared.

artifactTypes.label: Typed parameter registry
artifactTypes.description: Behavior-affecting parameters, caps, orderings, ties, units, valid domains, ownership, and provenance declarations.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.4 requires a parameter registry with type-aware valid values.
provenanceNotes: Duplicated sites and covarying units remain visible rather than silently normalized.

artifactTypes.label: Parameter perturbation policy
artifactTypes.description: Frozen valid-value sweep, covariance, ordering, tie, cap, and reporting rules for sensitivity measurement.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.4 requires type-aware perturbation of every tunable behavior site.
provenanceNotes: Invalid one-at-a-time sweeps and omitted correlated changes are explicitly ruled out or recorded.

artifactTypes.label: Parameter sensitivity report
artifactTypes.description: Mover counts, role destinations, sensitivity curves, inert sites, cliffs, correlated changes, displacement, and provenance gaps.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Sensitivity diagnostic that does not decide which changed destination is better.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.4 defines the parameter and cap sensitivity census.
provenanceNotes: Each result identifies the exact registry site, perturbation, run, and affected outputs.

artifactTypes.label: Configured source roots
artifactTypes.description: Explicit repository-relative TypeScript and Python source roots presented to the numeric provenance scanner.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.6 requires configured TypeScript and Python roots.
provenanceNotes: Skipped, excluded, and self-scan roots remain explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Numeric provenance scan configuration
artifactTypes.description: Language rules, named exclusions, nearby provenance tags, decision index, and deterministic report policy.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.6 defines exclusions, provenance tags, and a decision index.
provenanceNotes: Configuration identifies the scanner revision and conservative classification rules.

artifactTypes.label: Numeric literal provenance scan report
artifactTypes.description: Stable lower-bound findings, exclusions, tunable status, provenance classes, language fidelity, backlog, skipped files, limitations, and body hash.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.6 defines a deterministic lower-bound scanner report.
provenanceNotes: The report includes scanner identity and source-root coverage; it does not claim complete behavior-site coverage.

artifactTypes.label: Exported behavior surfaces
artifactTypes.description: Exported constants, configuration, policy declarations, enums, and generated configuration visible for reconciliation.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.5 requires exported configuration and declared policy surfaces.
provenanceNotes: Generated and dependency-default surfaces identify their source and revision.

artifactTypes.label: Behavior surface inventory
artifactTypes.description: Independent inventory of branches, prompts, ties, ordering, seeds, conversions, decoders, corpus rules, caps, deduplication, and fallbacks.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.5 requires cross-surface behavior-site reconciliation beyond numeric literals.
provenanceNotes: Coverage and explicitly uninspected surfaces are part of the inventory contract.

artifactTypes.label: Author parameter declarations
artifactTypes.description: Named owner, unit, rationale, provenance, and intended policy declarations for behavior-affecting sites.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.5 includes author declarations in reconciliation.
provenanceNotes: Declarations are evidence inputs, not authorization or proof that values are good.

artifactTypes.label: Parameter provenance reconciliation
artifactTypes.description: Deterministic declared-only, code-only, anonymous, duplicated, or provenance-mismatched census with owners, units, gaps, and uncovered surfaces.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Independent behavior-site census; it neither chooses values nor grants authority.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.5 defines the full reconciliation output.
provenanceNotes: Every input inventory revision and coverage limit is bound to the report.

artifactTypes.label: Typed observation set
artifactTypes.description: Observations carrying declared unit, pairing, population, and design identity for an applicable statistical calculation.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.7 requires typed observations and design declarations.
provenanceNotes: Types preserve declarations but do not prove that the declarations are true.

artifactTypes.label: Statistical design declaration
artifactTypes.description: Method, minimum sample, correction, pairing, population, units, preregistration, and refusal conditions.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.7 requires design declarations and minimum-condition checks.
provenanceNotes: Method and correction identities are frozen before result interpretation.

artifactTypes.label: Provenance-carrying statistical result
artifactTypes.description: Numeric result carrying method, sample size, corrections, assumptions, and caveats.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Applicable typed inference result; it does not convert a proxy into product evidence.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.7 defines the successful typed statistical result.
provenanceNotes: The result is emitted only when declared assumptions and minimum conditions are representable as satisfied.

artifactTypes.label: Typed statistical refusal
artifactTypes.description: Distinct no-number outcome naming failed assumptions, insufficient sample conditions, and applicable caveats.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Explicit statistical refusal with no numeric field.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.7 requires misuse to be unrepresentable as a numeric result.
provenanceNotes: The refusal retains method and design identities without a numeric payload.

artifactTypes.label: Sealed natural candidate run
artifactTypes.description: Naturally produced candidate outputs joined by exact source identity and sealed before any protected review-custody join.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.8 and 7.10 require candidate or paired runs.
provenanceNotes: No review field, target, expected output, or custody mapping is present in the sealed run.

artifactTypes.label: Sealed baseline run
artifactTypes.description: Baseline outputs joined by exact source identity and sealed independently of protected review records.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.8 permits an optional baseline and 7.10 requires baseline outputs.
provenanceNotes: The baseline is immutable and contains no review-derived encoding.

artifactTypes.label: Same-color comparison rule
artifactTypes.description: Frozen exact or declared same-color equivalence and comparison tolerances for adjudication.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.8 requires a same-color rule.
provenanceNotes: Rule revision is reported with every destination classification.

artifactTypes.label: Standing evidence adjudication report
artifactTypes.description: Per-item win, loss, or no-signal destinations, contradictions, era strata, reachability, movers, and explicit non-gating status without a score.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Non-gating prior-verdict destination diagnostic; it is not current quality evidence.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.8 requires exact destinations and gating set to none.
provenanceNotes: Candidate output is sealed before the harness joins dated protected evidence.

artifactTypes.label: Blast-radius adjudication report
artifactTypes.description: Mover set, endorsement or known-worse destinations, unknowns, asymmetry, and census coverage with no aggregate winner.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Changed-destination accounting diagnostic; movement alone is not harm or improvement.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.10 defines changed-destination accounting.
provenanceNotes: Paired outputs are sealed before protected records are joined by the evaluation harness.

artifactTypes.label: Unresolved mover review sample
artifactTypes.description: Preregistered unresolved changed-output sample handed to a separate human review process without an aggregate winner label.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: External human-review handoff for unresolved changed destinations.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.10 includes an unresolved review sample.
provenanceNotes: Sampling policy, exposure, duplicate component, source hashes, and omitted movers are recorded.

artifactTypes.label: Protected append-only review warehouse
artifactTypes.description: File-ordered autosave snapshots with full verdict, comment, exposure, batch, item, and supersession custody.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.11 and STRATEGY.md 7 require append-only protected review custody.
provenanceNotes: This protected store is harness-only and cannot enter natural, known-good consumer, cache, fitter, or runtime inputs.

artifactTypes.label: Protected latest-verdict store
artifactTypes.description: Deduplicated latest verdicts by batch and item, retaining comments, endorsements, vetoes, exposures, and superseded history in protected custody.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.11 defines latest-verdict deduplication by batch and item.
provenanceNotes: Only harness-side scoring and adjudication may read this store after candidate outputs are sealed.

artifactTypes.label: Candidate entry-point declaration
artifactTypes.description: Repository-local candidate entry point and resolution policy for dependency-closure measurement.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.9 requires a candidate entry point.
provenanceNotes: The resolution policy and repository boundary are versioned.

artifactTypes.label: Repository-local source closure
artifactTypes.description: Recursively resolved repository-local TypeScript import closure with exact file identities.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.9 requires recursive repository-local import closure.
provenanceNotes: Unresolved, dynamic, generated, and external dependencies remain explicit limitations.

artifactTypes.label: Content-addressed development cache values
artifactTypes.description: Cached values keyed by exact input bytes and measured computation identity for stale-safe development reuse.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.9 includes cached values as development-loop inputs.
provenanceNotes: Cache keys contain no review, source-identity shortcut, or expected-output field.

artifactTypes.label: Development run manifest
artifactTypes.description: Complete immutable run membership, source byte identities, code closure, configuration, outputs, and failure states.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.9 compares two complete run manifests.
provenanceNotes: Path joins retain a separately visible source-byte change flag.

artifactTypes.label: Content-addressed development-loop report
artifactTypes.description: Source-closure hash, stale-safe cache hits or misses, and deterministic changed, missing, failing, working, per-role, gradient, and collapse records.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Development cache and run-diff diagnostic; it orders attention but does not decide improvement.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.9 defines dependency-closed cache and run-diff outputs.
provenanceNotes: The report binds entry point, measured closure, bytes, cache identity, and both manifests.

artifactTypes.label: Immutable mechanism-native output
artifactTypes.description: A mechanism output in its native semantic form with alternatives, uncertainty, abstention, and exact source witnesses.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.12 requires immutable source and mechanism artifacts.
provenanceNotes: Mechanism, artifact schema, source bytes, and native witness identities are frozen before review.

artifactTypes.label: Semantic review question contract
artifactTypes.description: Frozen semantic question, answer vocabulary, acceptance scope, ambiguity, no-answer, free-text, interpretation, and stop rules.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.12 and STRATEGY.md 5 require a frozen question contract.
provenanceNotes: Question wording and answer affordances receive content identity before responses open.

artifactTypes.label: Review presentation control
artifactTypes.description: Blinding claim, independent identifiability audit, ordered presentation, exposure tracking, and side or item randomization controls.
sourceNotes: STRATEGY.md 5 and 7 require audited presentation, blinding, and exposure controls.
provenanceNotes: Every visible or inferable identity channel and randomization rule is recorded.

artifactTypes.label: Protected semantic-review store
artifactTypes.description: Append-only question-scoped acceptance, rejection, ambiguity, no-answer, free text, presentation identity, exposure, alternatives, and supersession custody.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Human semantic-review endpoint for the frozen mechanism question; it is not complete-treatment quality.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.12 and STRATEGY.md 5-7 define scoped semantic review custody.
provenanceNotes: The protected store never enters a diagnostic consumer; only an independent minimal projection step may read it.

artifactTypes.label: Rendered complete UI treatment
artifactTypes.description: Pinned-rendition joint rendering of the complete treatment, suitable for absolute or blinded pairwise product review.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.13 requires one or two rendered complete treatments.
provenanceNotes: Treatment, source, renderer, rendition, and pixel output identities are frozen.

artifactTypes.label: Complete-treatment side randomization
artifactTypes.description: Frozen side assignment, concealment, absolute or pairwise mode, and reviewer separation controls.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.13 requires side randomization for pairwise review.
provenanceNotes: The seed, assignment algorithm, and identifiability audit are recorded before review.

artifactTypes.label: Protected complete-treatment quality review
artifactTypes.description: Append-only absolute grades or pairwise preferences, comments, ambiguity, optional endorsed samples, exact rendition, and exposure custody.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Human product-quality endpoint for complete rendered treatments; it is separate from contract validity and semantic review.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.13 defines the complete-treatment human endpoint.
provenanceNotes: This protected quality record cannot enter cold inference or be treated as unique ground truth.

artifactTypes.label: Sealed natural producer output
artifactTypes.description: Naturally generated upstream semantic value, including uncertainty, abstention, invalidity, or out-of-domain state, sealed without any protected review field.
sourceNotes: STRATEGY.md 6.2 requires natural and known-good conditions to remain distinct.
provenanceNotes: This natural output has no producer in this fragment and contains no reviewed target, custody mapping, or answer-equivalent encoding.

artifactTypes.label: Declared consumer input contract
artifactTypes.description: Exact semantic value, uncertainty, abstention, coordinate, unit, source-witness, null, and out-of-domain fields accepted by one diagnostic consumer.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 and STRATEGY.md 6.1 require a declared consumer input contract.
provenanceNotes: The contract excludes review identity, verdict, chronology, sibling cardinality, and downstream-answer fields.

artifactTypes.label: Known-good projection schema
artifactTypes.description: Versioned minimal projection schema and target-sufficiency or metadata-channel audit rules for one declared consumer.
sourceNotes: STRATEGY.md 6.1 requires a content-hashed minimal schema and independent leakage audit.
provenanceNotes: Any answer-recoverable standard projection fails rather than being relabeled.

artifactTypes.label: Accepted-alternative sampling rule
artifactTypes.description: Frozen non-outcome-selected all-alternatives, risk-stratified, or budget-limited sampling and condition-matrix policy.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 and STRATEGY.md 6.2 require accepted-alternative sampling without best-outcome selection.
provenanceNotes: Omitted cells, spread, worst cases, and every tested alternative remain reportable.

artifactTypes.label: Known-good minimal projection
artifactTypes.description: Content-hashed consumer-facing semantic value with only required uncertainty, abstention, coordinates, units, and source witnesses.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 defines the leak-audited minimal known-good projection as a declared consumer-facing handoff.
provenanceNotes: It excludes the reviewed artifact, all custody fields, identifiers, verdicts, corrections, chronology, sibling metadata, and answer equivalents.

artifactTypes.label: Sealed known-good consumer result
artifactTypes.description: Consumer output produced from one accepted minimal projection and sealed before the harness rejoins protected custody.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Conditional consumer diagnostic; it does not establish natural handoff, generalization, runtime competence, or product quality.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 requires consumer output to be sealed before custody join.
provenanceNotes: The consumer can address the projection hash but cannot access its protected-store mapping.

artifactTypes.label: Known-good firewall audit
artifactTypes.description: Target-sufficiency, removable-metadata deletion, nonsemantic permutation, regenerated-ID, alternative-reordering, and trivial-decoder audit result.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Leakage audit for a standard known-good projection and sealed consumer result.
sourceNotes: STRATEGY.md 6.1 defines the required metadata-channel audit.
provenanceNotes: A changed output or trivially recoverable answer records study failure.

artifactTypes.label: Natural versus known-good gap report
artifactTypes.description: Per-alternative conditional results, perturbation and null cells, spread, worst cases, disagreements, and natural-known-good gap without a product-quality claim.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Condition-matrix localization diagnostic separating conditional competence from natural handoff and complete-treatment quality.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 and STRATEGY.md 6.2 define the natural-known-good comparison.
provenanceNotes: Natural output, protected custody, projection, and sealed consumer outputs retain distinct identities.

artifactTypes.label: Source and artifact custody graph
artifactTypes.description: Typed parent graph carrying source bytes, dimensions, decoder, code, configuration, coordinates, typed-array encoding, renderer, and failed derivation identities.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.15 requires source and artifact graph custody.
provenanceNotes: All parent edges identify full content hashes rather than filename or prefix aliases.

artifactTypes.label: Content-addressed artifact manifest
artifactTypes.description: Canonical artifact identities, parent hashes, Merkle roots, reconstruction instructions, and custody certificates.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.15 defines canonical identities, manifests, and certificates.
provenanceNotes: Hashes establish identity and stale-evidence detection, not truth.

artifactTypes.label: Independent artifact reconstruction report
artifactTypes.description: Independent replay result naming exact matches, first divergence, stale parents, mixed evidence, and reconstruction limitations.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Independent custody and reconstruction diagnostic.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.15 requires independent reconstruction results.
provenanceNotes: The verifier identity and all observed content hashes are retained.

artifactTypes.label: Failed artifact-attempt ledger
artifactTypes.description: Append-only content-addressed preservation of invalid, incomplete, stale, or reconstruction-failed attempts.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Governance record preserving failed attempts rather than overwriting them.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.15 requires failed-attempt preservation.
provenanceNotes: Supersession adds records and never mutates prior attempt identity.

artifactTypes.label: Synthetic fixture generation contract
artifactTypes.description: Exact uniform, split, checker, frame, thin-line, ramp, speck, seeded-noise, identity, scale, reflection, and rotation declarations.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.16 enumerates exact fixtures and metamorphic transforms.
provenanceNotes: Dimensions, colors, coordinates, seeds, transform order, and expected predicates are frozen.

artifactTypes.label: Synthetic exact fixture bundle
artifactTypes.description: Generated exact fixture and transformed-raster bytes with recomputed fields, expected predicates, coordinates, and deterministic hashes.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.16 defines exact fixture and transform outputs.
provenanceNotes: Synthetic identity is explicit and never represented as a natural source observation.

artifactTypes.label: Synthetic control verification report
artifactTypes.description: Exact byte, structural predicate, transformed-field, coordinate, and deterministic-hash verification result.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Mechanical synthetic-control diagnostic; passing cannot select a scale, segmentation, role, or palette.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.16 limits support to declared synthetic behavior.
provenanceNotes: Every check binds the fixture contract, generator identity, and output hash.

artifactTypes.label: Privileged answer-bearing projection
artifactTypes.description: Minimum declared answer-equivalent semantic value for one separately identified upper-bound consumer, excluding every raw review and custody field.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.17 and STRATEGY.md 6.1 define the distinct answer-bearing-upper-bound class.
provenanceNotes: This privileged external root is not a known-good projection and cannot be derived by relabeling a failed standard projection.

artifactTypes.label: Answer-bearing upper-bound declaration
artifactTypes.description: Dedicated consumer, experiment, supplied-answer semantics, minimum-content, comparison, labeling, and prohibited-claim declaration.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.17 requires dedicated identities and an exact declaration of supplied semantics.
provenanceNotes: The declaration bars fitting, natural-handoff, generalization, runtime, quality, and advancement reuse.

artifactTypes.label: Privileged answer-bearing diagnostic result
artifactTypes.description: Separately labeled output from the dedicated upper-bound consumer, never mixed with ordinary consumer results.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Privileged non-generalizing upper-bound diagnostic.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.17 requires a separately labeled privileged result.
provenanceNotes: The result binds the projection and declaration hashes and remains barred from natural-mechanism fitting.

artifactTypes.label: Privileged upper-bound comparison record
artifactTypes.description: Exact comparison record naming supplied answer-equivalent semantics and preserving separation from natural and known-good results.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Privileged comparison diagnostic with no runtime, product-quality, generalization, or advancement authority.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.17 requires an exact comparison record.
provenanceNotes: No verdict, grade, comment, preference, correction, exposure, source identity, or custody metadata enters the consumer.

The exact UI treatment contract remains an unproduced product-goal input to structural validation; no Section 7 mechanism is represented as a palette producer.
Mechanical contract scorecards and protected complete-treatment quality records are distinct artifact types and cannot substitute for one another.
Sealed natural producer output, protected review stores, known-good minimal projections, and privileged answer-bearing projections are distinct types with distinct input classes and custody rules.
